get.description: Returns currency USD, integer balance_minor (cents), decimal-string balance and funding_enabled. With a connected supplier, customers can create crypto top-up invoices in the Wallet page. Credit is added only after confirmed provider payment and credit. There is no public invoice-creation API endpoint.

There is no public invoice-creation API endpoint.
x-description.ru: Возвращает USD, целый balance_minor в центах, строку balance и funding_enabled. При подключённом поставщике клиент создаёт счёт криптопополнения в кошельке. Кредит зачисляется только после подтверждения платежа и зачисления поставщиком. Публичного метода создания счетов API нет.

get.description: Without category_id returns categories (id/name). With category_id returns products: id, name, kind, currency, unit_price_minor, min_quantity, max_quantity, stock, fields and region. Telegram kinds return products directly. Use fields key (or code), required and options to construct the buyer form. Prices can change; request a quote before purchasing. No connected supplier returns an empty catalog.

x-description.ru: Без category_id возвращает categories (id/name). С category_id возвращает товары: id, name, kind, currency, unit_price_minor, min_quantity, max_quantity, stock, fields и region. post.description: Creates a real purchase using your KEYPLO credit. Send a stable Idempotency-Key (16–100 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores). Same key + same body returns the same order; different body returns 409. Never retry an unknown order with a new key. Responses contain the local id, status, amount_minor, currency, external_id and delivery codes when completed. HTTP 200 does not mean delivery is complete: inspect status. Pending supplier errors retain the reservation for reconciliation. No automatic retry of an uncertain supplier purchase.

x-description.en: Creates a real purchase using your KEYPLO credit. Send a stable Idempotency-Key (16–100 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores). Same key + same body returns the same order; different body returns 409. Never retry an unknown order with a new key. Responses contain the local id, status, amount_minor, currency, external_id and delivery codes when completed. HTTP 200 does not mean delivery is complete: inspect status. Pending supplier errors retain the reservation for reconciliation. No automatic retry of an uncertain supplier purchase.
x-description.ru: Создаёт реальную покупку с баланса KEYPLO. Передавайте постоянный Idempotency-Key (16–100 букв, цифр, дефисов или подчёркиваний). Тот же ключ и тело возвращают тот же заказ; другое тело — 409. Не повторяйте неопределённый заказ с новым ключом. Ответ содержит локальный id, status, amount_minor, currency, external_id и коды delivery после выполнения. HTTP 200 не означает выдачу: проверьте status. При неопределённом ответе поставщика резерв сохраняется для сверки. Автоматического повторного выкупа нет.

get.description: Returns only your own order; foreign or unknown ID returns 404. Known processing orders are refreshed from the supplier. States: reserved, submitting, processing, completed, failed, refunded, unknown, needs_review. Completed delivery codes appear in delivery. Confirmed refunds credit the original debit once; read errors never trigger refunds. Unknown/needs_review requires owner reconciliation.

x-description.en: Returns only your own order; foreign or unknown ID returns 404. Known processing orders are refreshed from the supplier. States: reserved, submitting, processing, completed, failed, refunded, unknown, needs_review. Completed delivery codes appear in delivery. Confirmed refunds credit the original debit once; read errors never trigger refunds. Unknown/needs_review requires owner reconciliation.
x-description.ru: Возвращает только ваш заказ; чужой или неизвестный ID — 404. Выполняемые заказы с известным ID проверяются у поставщика. Статусы: reserved, submitting, processing, completed, failed, refunded, unknown, needs_review. Коды выполненного заказа — в delivery. Подтверждённый возврат зачисляется один раз; ошибка чтения не вызывает возврат. unknown/needs_review требуют сверки владельцем.
